Professional profile

Software Engineer and AI/ML Engineer with more than six years of combined experience across full-stack software development, information systems, automation, data analytics, and applied AI. My work connects technical implementation with practical organizational value: reducing manual effort, improving access to information, strengthening operational visibility, and supporting better decisions.
